post.caption: Halle Berry won wearing a pumpkin. An eleven carat brownish orange diamond was found in Africa in 1997, and master cutter William Goldberg cut it down to a gem graded Fancy Vivid Orange. Sotheby's sold it the night before Halloween, and Ronald Winston of Harry Winston bought it and named it the Pumpkin Diamond. Set in a ring between two smaller white diamonds, it was worn by Halle Berry to the 2002 Oscars, where she won Best Actress for Monster's Ball. The Pumpkin Diamond weighs 5.54 carats.
